name: Kyrie
source:
Who could possibly be a more respected being in Fluffland than the God of fluffs? Thus Kyrie, as his spokesperson, also has a large influence. Despite that, he lives in the mysterious Glowing Forest, away from the fluffs in the Capital, and his activities are unknown.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
